notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sU5-5jVPJaA;full][/previewyoutube]

VERSION UPDATE V.0.1.8.1

Game changes 


 Max resolution downgrade from 1080p to 720p
 New challenge mission gameplay mode with free roam RPG style
 Added Shin Gojira for AI
 Change max HP to 500 from 200
 Slow down character's speed
 Added 3 New characters for Player 1 
 Cut off Survival mode as Mission mode will be come key feature of the game


Know issues


 2P mode may not work properly
 Game may still take sometime for download as it's know issues for the engine that being development


If game not run or crash please see this basic trouble shooting method https://steamcommunity.com/app/1420580/discussions/0/3110269213854969272/

Any feedback are welcome!

notes.title: UPDATE Ver.0.1.8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/1337ba07c86dc1e925d371a40910fd85fcb76882.png

December wave 1 update 5 more characters from commissions to the game

There're various change in gameplay, here is some changed

Change invincibility time from 0.1 to 0.15 (Now hit and received damage will have more gap from each attack to prevent unavoidable combo chains) 
Game will run in fullscreen mode when launch by default
Enemy AI will be generated in random level setting. You can specified them by its size and health bar 


The game may received a bit slow update than usual due to my health problem.

Hope you have fun playing this game and make some more kaiju flick to the world.

Peace!

notes.title: Update patch V0.1.7.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/f75a5f4370d0f816e2e11ed989ff3dff66babb4b.jpg

V0.1.7.3 features lists

-New Keyboards input method
-Database menu "Profile" unlock
-Instant Unlock everythings option via Research menu
-Coins covert option via Research menu
-AI now spawn with 3 diferrent Levels setting (Small noticed by its size)
-Cut off some particle effect objects to make game run better

Keyboards Control change(No mouse involved)

Move = W,A,S,D
J = Attack
K = Heavy Attack
L = Special Attack
Space = OK
Back Space = Cancel
Q = Zoom

notes.title: HOT PATCH VER.0.1.7 NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/0af7d0e98bcac93fdfc41db8fee3a24683a77e51.png

DAIKAIJU DAIKESSEN: VERSUS (VER.0.1.7)

This is a hot patch to fixed various problem from community feedback
Here's the lists of some changing


 Ability to reselect character in character select screen
 Reworks FX for better performance
 Cutout some unnecessary object for better performance
 Game now become much more faster for better gaming experience( Please give me some feedback if this change suitable for you or not)


Bugs fixed


 Fixed strange bugs on select screen in Battle Arena 2P mode
 Fixed variables to able to check and recieved new input method while in select screen and battle stage


Tips


 The game now will open in full screen mode (You can enable/disable it by pressing ESC)
 When pausing game you can press cancel (By default is B on Xbox controller or RMB) to quit the match anytime
 Press F5 to reset the game ( it can fixed controller issues to default setting and wait for new input method you give, instead of forcing you to only use keyboard and mouse)
 Press F1 to see more settings option
